products.name: AXIS
products.description:
AXIS is crafted from treated solid wood, selected for its natural grain and durability. Its refined circular form, precision black hands, and silent movement deliver seamless timekeeping with understated elegance.

Designed for refined interiors, AXIS adds quiet sophistication and lasting character to modern spaces.
